software_baseline.description: Last successful combined CORE, Studio and Android GitHub CI before OTA/update changes (not a physical hardware pass)

physical_baseline.note: Historical user-observed bench results only; no v0.1.30 physical pass has been recorded. The 0.1.28 flash SHA is not evidenced.

physical_cases.description: Genuine PC817 IN1–IN8 masks GPIO4–11; combinations 0,12,14,15,31,224,255
Brake overrides park; lights only in assigned zones
Both turns and brake+hazards with real opto inputs
Reverse overrides only reverse zones; other effects continue
Show uninterrupted in unrelated zones and resumes after trigger release
GPIO16 and GPIO17 independently drive configured output lengths
Non-GS400 arbitrary zone counts, zero-based offsets, no hardcoded roles
GRB correct red/amber/white and bench cap observed, power current measured
Existing output/trigger/preset configs survive flash and power restart, v1 migration
White/cyan/green/red/rainbow/fault physical timing and colors
Emergency Stop, effect expiry and trigger restoration on actual LEDs
Actual Android BLE authorize, disconnect/reconnect, profile read/write
Measured FPS on 522/30 LEDs and smooth fades at low brightness
Measured physical strobe rise/fall, no easing or missed input preemption
Event Horizon final color, Singularity shutdown full black, startup previews
Borrowed effects: true source-equivalent frames/Fireworks 1D and particle behavior
Legacy single-app to OTA dual-slot migration preserves NVS, no full erase
OTA upload validation, reboot health and failed-image rollback
Reject arbitrary LAN clients/cross-origin, invalid/older firmware, truncation
Browser visual verification against locked OLED UI, layout edits, trigger tests, sequences
On-device native Android UI, BLE controls, no WebView substituted for required native screens
